semiconductor_relevance: High — TBSTest Technologies specializes in automatic test equipment for integrated circuits, making it a key player in the semiconductor testing segment.
summary: TBSTest Technologies Co., LTD. develops and manufactures a range of automatic test equipment for large scale integrated circuits, focusing on high-end SOC test systems and various test solutions. The company aims to provide high-quality IC testing services to clients in the semiconductor industry, including design and production firms as well as research institutions.
capabilities: Multi-circuit and multi-mode simulation test boards

regional_presence.China: TBSTest has a strong focus on cultivating the Chinese market while also aiming for global outreach.
